Action.description: A step that a reader can take after the tour.
Action.title: Action

AddRow.description: A line that the head commit adds.
AddRow.title: AddRow

Anchor.description:
Where an inline comment points, on one side of the diff. `lines` is None when no line of the
page holds the code that the comment was left on, so the comment keeps only its file.
Anchor.title: Anchor

Aside.description: A question that a reader can ask about a stop, with its answer.
Aside.title: Aside

Band.description: A part that the tour does not walk through, with its files.
Band.title: Band

Chapter.description: A chapter of the tour, with its stops.
Chapter.title: Chapter

ChapterLines.description: The lines of a chapter that a reader reads and that a reader skims.
ChapterLines.title: ChapterLines

ChapterSection.description: A titled group of stops inside a chapter.
ChapterSection.title: ChapterSection

Check.description: A question that a reader can answer at the end of the tour.
Check.title: Check

CodeBlock.description: A block that shows code from the page files.
CodeBlock.title: CodeBlock

Column.description: A column of a table. The key names the cell in each row.
Column.title: Column

ColumnKind.description: How a table column draws its cells.
ColumnKind.title: ColumnKind

CommentKind.description: Where a review comment sits on GitHub.
CommentKind.title: CommentKind

CommentRef.description: The name of one comment: GitHub ids are unique only within a comment kind.
CommentRef.title: CommentRef

DelRow.description: A line that the base commit deletes.
DelRow.title: DelRow

DiscussionBlock.description: A block with the review comments of the pull request.
DiscussionBlock.title: DiscussionBlock

Element.description: A named thing that the page draws, such as a function, a file range, or a person.
Element.title: Element

ElementCell.description: A table cell that names an element.
ElementCell.title: ElementCell

ElementKind.description: The kind of an element, which tells a reader what the element names.
ElementKind.title: ElementKind

Ending.description: The closing checks and actions of the tour.
Ending.title: Ending

Facet.description: One way to group the elements of the page.
Facet.title: Facet

FacetCell.description: A table cell that names one option of a facet.
FacetCell.title: FacetCell

FacetId.description: The axis that a facet groups the elements by.
FacetId.title: FacetId

FacetOption.description: One value of a facet, with the elements that it selects.
FacetOption.title: FacetOption

FieldRow.description: A field that the change adds, removes, or keeps with its type.
FieldRow.title: FieldRow

File.description: One changed file of the pull request.
File.title: File

FileCell.description: A table cell that names a line of a file.
FileCell.title: FileCell

Flag.description: A note that the tour raises before the first chapter.
Flag.title: Flag

FlagKind.description: The kind of a flag. Only a warning exists today.
FlagKind.title: FlagKind

Fold.description: How many rows a table shows before the rest fold away.
Fold.title: Fold

FoldedRow.description: Fields that the box does not show one by one, counted by how they changed.
FoldedRow.title: FoldedRow

Group.description: A group of table rows that folds under one heading.
Group.title: Group

Hunk.description: One hunk of a diff, with its rows.
Hunk.title: Hunk

HunkPicture.description: A picture of diff windows in one file.
HunkPicture.title: HunkPicture

Icon.description: The icon that a section or a view shows.
Icon.title: Icon

InStop.description: An element appearance in a tour stop.
InStop.title: InStop

InView.description: An element appearance in a view.
InView.title: InView

InlineComment.description: A comment on a line of the diff. A reply takes the anchor of the thread that it answers.
InlineComment.title: InlineComment

InterfaceNode.description:
An interface, such as a Rust trait or a Python Protocol, drawn as a box with no rows.
Its arrows are the records that implement it and the interfaces that it extends.
InterfaceNode.title: InterfaceNode

IssueComment.description: A comment on the conversation of the pull request.
IssueComment.title: IssueComment

KeepRow.description: A line that both commits keep.
KeepRow.title: KeepRow

Kind.description: The line-accounting kind of a file.
Kind.title: Kind

KindLines.description: The line counts of one kind inside a file.
KindLines.title: KindLines

Lang.description:
The languages a repo can be read as. `NONE` is a repo with no provider. In `profile.json`
the id is the plain string, and `Lang(text)` at the boundary raises on an unknown one.
Lang.title: Lang

ListCell.description: A table cell with a list of cells that cannot hold another list.
ListCell.title: ListCell

MadeBy.description: The rule that marked a file, and the note that the rule gives.
MadeBy.title: MadeBy

MadeRule.description: The rule that marked a file as generated or vendored.
MadeRule.title: MadeRule

MapPackage.description: A package on the map, with its files.
MapPackage.title: MapPackage

Meta.description: The facts about the pull request as a whole.
Meta.title: Meta

NarrationBlock.description: A block with text that the agent wrote.
NarrationBlock.title: NarrationBlock

NumberCell.description: A table cell with a number.
NumberCell.title: NumberCell

Part.description: A group of files that the change treats as one unit.
Part.title: Part

PartFile.description: A file inside a part, with its line counts.
PartFile.title: PartFile

PartKind.description: The kind of a part, in the order that the parts table lists them.
PartKind.title: PartKind

PrState.description: The state of a pull request.
PrState.title: PrState

Range.description: A line range in one file. Both lines are 1-based and inclusive.
Range.title: Range

Rank.description: How much a table row matters. A key row comes first and a minor row comes last.
Rank.title: Rank

RecordNode.description:
A record type, drawn as a box with one row per shown field.

`was` is the base qualified name if the type moved or was renamed. `kind_change` names a change
of its kind, such as "TypedDict → dataclass". `hidden` counts the types that the size cap folded
into this node.
RecordNode.title: RecordNode

Ref.description: A place in the diff that backs an element. A ref names the base path or the head path, or both.
Ref.title: Ref

Relation.description: What an edge of a type map says about its two nodes.
Relation.title: Relation

Rely.description: An element that the stop relies on, with the code that defines it.
Rely.title: Rely

RelyCode.description: The lines of code that a reliance points at.
RelyCode.title: RelyCode

RelyWhy.description: How a stop's changed code meets an unchanged function that it relies on, best first.
RelyWhy.title: RelyWhy

RetypedRow.description: A field that stays and changes its type. Only this row has an old type.
RetypedRow.title: RetypedRow

Rev.description: A named revision and the commit that it points at.
Rev.title: Rev

ReviewComment.description: The text of a submitted review, with its verdict.
ReviewComment.title: ReviewComment

ReviewState.description: The verdict of a submitted review.
ReviewState.title: ReviewState

Section.description: A section of the page. A section with no views still gives its reason.
Section.title: Section

SectionId.description: A section of the page, in the order that the page lists them.
SectionId.title: SectionId

SeqPicture.description: A picture in SVG with a hot map from its shapes to elements.
SeqPicture.title: SeqPicture

ShipHunks.description: A file that the page ships as hunks, with the reason.
ShipHunks.title: ShipHunks

ShipWhole.description: A file that the page ships whole, with the full text of each side. A side is null if the file does not exist there.
ShipWhole.title: ShipWhole

Side.description: The side of a diff: the base commit or the head commit.
Side.title: Side

Span.description: The lines of one side of a hunk. An empty side starts at the line after the gap.
Span.title: Span

Status.description: How an element changed in the pull request.
Status.title: Status

StatusCell.description: A table cell with the status of an element.
StatusCell.title: StatusCell

Stop.description: One stop of a chapter. A stop holds each changed line once.
Stop.title: Stop

StopFile.description: A file that a stop or a band covers, with its line counts.
StopFile.title: StopFile

SummaryBlock.description: A block with a list of summary items.
SummaryBlock.title: SummaryBlock

SummaryItem.description: One line of a summary, with the view that it links to.
SummaryItem.title: SummaryItem

SvgBlock.description: A block with a picture in SVG. The hot map gives the element that each shape names.
SvgBlock.title: SvgBlock

TableRow.description: A row of a table, with its cells by column key.
TableRow.title: TableRow

TextBlock.description: A block with text that the producer wrote.
TextBlock.title: TextBlock

TextCell.description: A table cell with plain text.
TextCell.title: TextCell

ToComment.description: A target that opens a review comment.
ToComment.title: ToComment

ToElement.description: A target that opens an element.
ToElement.title: ToElement

ToView.description: A target that opens a view.
ToView.title: ToView

Tour.description: The guided tour of the pull request.
Tour.title: Tour

TypeEdge.description:
A link between two nodes. `field` names the row it leaves from, or None for a union member or
a base class. `tag` is the value that picks a union member, such as "kind=hunk".
TypeEdge.title: TypeEdge

TypeMap.description: A type map of both sides of the change.
TypeMap.title: TypeMap

TypeMapBlock.description: A block with a type map. The map carries its own title and note.
TypeMapBlock.title: TypeMapBlock

UnionNode.description: A union of records, drawn as a "one of" node with an edge to each member.
UnionNode.title: UnionNode

Verdict.description: How much of a part or a stop a reader must read.
Verdict.title: Verdict

View.description: One view of the page, with its blocks in order.
View.title: View

ViewId.description: A view that the page can show.
ViewId.title: ViewId

Window.description: A pair of line ranges, one per side, that a picture shows.
Window.title: Window

description: One page of data for one pull request.
title: Page
